fact: A paper published 2025-10-29 by authors including Dah Abdellahi Bellahi of the Universite de Nouakchott analyses Mauritania's e-government and digital transformation through the EGDI, E-Participation, NRI and IDI indices.

Rim Now reports that the Mauritanian Centre for Humanitarian Research and Studies (Mabda) held a roundtable in Nouakchott on artificial intelligence as a lever for education and employability, with academics and researchers.

Initiatives News reports that the think tank Mauritanie Perspectives, with Global Development Network support, held a workshop in Nouakchott on 2 March 2024 on digitalisation and citizenship, with recommendations for the authorities to follow.

GDN's programme page lists Mauritanie Perspectives in a research consortium on how digitalisation of public services reshapes inequalities and institutional trust, presented at the Cotonou forum of 7-9 July 2026.
